## Why

Describe the developer problem this change fixes. Link the owning issue.

## What changes

Explain the resulting CLI behavior and any platform-specific limits.

## Validation

Record commands, runtime/platform, full tested head SHA, passed checks, and missing native coverage.
Do not equate injected platform fixtures with execution on that platform.

## Review and delivery

KETA review and specific user merge approval follow `docs/git-workflow.md`.
